chosen.premise: Vulpix releases flames from its mouth during hot days so its body does not overheat.
chosen.hook: Vulpix breathes fire to stop itself from getting too hot.
chosen.visualIdea: A heat gauge rises beside Vulpix, then drops as flames stream from its mouth.
chosen.note: A genuinely counterintuitive survival mechanic: Vulpix expels fire to avoid overheating. The direct Pokédex evidence cleanly supports the hook.

candidates.premise: Against a stronger enemy, Vulpix feigns injury instead of fighting and escapes while it is fooled.
candidates.hook: Vulpix's best battle move might be pretending it already lost.
candidates.visualIdea: A larger opponent approaches as Vulpix acts hurt, then sprints away the moment its trick works.
candidates.note: Distinctive tactical behavior with a clear beginning, deception, and escape. It is strongly supported, though slightly less visually novel than the fire-temperature contradiction.

candidates.premise: Vulpix is born with one white tail that naturally splits into six as it matures.
candidates.hook: Vulpix doesn't grow more tails—it splits one into six.
candidates.visualIdea: Show one white tail splitting at its tip repeatedly until Vulpix has six warm, curled tails.
candidates.note: A highly Vulpix-specific transformation with excellent animation potential. Support is strong, but the Pokédex has conflicting entries about when it has six tails.

candidates.premise: One Pokédex entry says Vulpix's single tail separates into six when it receives plenty of love from its Trainer.
candidates.hook: For Vulpix, love isn't just emotional—it grows five more tails.
candidates.visualIdea: A Trainer lovingly cares for one white tail as it branches into six magnificent curls.
candidates.note: The emotional-to-physical mechanic is startling and concrete, but it relies on one entry and conflicts with other descriptions of Vulpix’s tail development.

candidates.premise: Vulpix's beautiful tails become a mass of tangles unless they are brushed diligently.
candidates.hook: Vulpix's legendary beauty comes with a daily brushing requirement.
candidates.visualIdea: Split-screen Vulpix shows glossy tails after brushing and a tangled mass when grooming is neglected.
candidates.note: A charming, concrete care requirement with an obvious before-and-after visual. It feels more like a grooming gag than the strongest defining episode premise.

candidates.premise: Vulpix's flames can resemble spirits of the deceased, causing people to mistake its fire for a ghost.
candidates.hook: People mistake Vulpix's fire for ghosts.
candidates.visualIdea: Vulpix launches eerie flame shapes that briefly resemble spirits before revealing its fiery attack.
candidates.note: The ghost confusion is well supported and easy to stage, but the premise is somewhat broader and less mechanically specific than Vulpix’s overheating behavior.

rounds.request: None; the chosen angle is strong enough. Stronger alternatives would need a comparably specific, surprising Vulpix-only rule with direct support and a visual contradiction or transformation.
